segments.text: Claire wants him to enjoy his birthday instead of spending half of it in line, so she promises to buy the iPad for him. She gets up early but accidentally falls asleep again on the couch. By the time she reaches the store, they’ve sold out.

segments.text: At Mitchell and Cameron’s house, they hear a strange man’s voice through Lily’s baby monitor and think someone has broken in. Mitchell freezes, while Cameron runs in to protect Lily. They soon discover that the monitor is picking up a signal from a neighbor’s house.
